info.heading: Personal Info
info.description: Full-stack TypeScript engineer with 6+ years of commercial experience building data-driven and visually rich web applications across React, Next.js, Remix and Node.js. My background in architecture and 3D graphics translates directly into work with UI design, Three.js/WebGL and interactive data visualization — areas I'm looking to deepen, particularly around digital twins and real-time 3D on the web. I've worked across startups and software houses, owning real-time features, design systems and performance-critical dashboards for Fortune 500 clients. I care about high-quality, maintainable code and polished interfaces, with a strong attention to visual detail and consistency.

items.label: Dec 2025 - Present
description: Improved application performance, scalability and Web Vitals by improving caching, memoization, eliminating layout reflows, lazy-loading routes and assets, and refactoring async data fetching — reducing unnecessary computation and client re-renders.
Owned an ETL pipeline (AWS S3 → PostgreSQL → Shopify) handling multi-type product ingestion, schema validation, and automated lifecycle reconciliation across data stores.
Maintained generated Zod schemas from OpenAPI specifications, enforcing type-safe API contracts and runtime validation across frontend and backend services.
Implemented real-time AI chatbot functionality over WebSockets, including streaming responses, interactive workflows, and connection health monitoring.
Drove a gradual data migration from a third-party commerce platform (Shopify) to PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM), moving product queries and assets to database-backed resources without service interruption.
Standardized error handling and improved observability across microservices with shared error types and unified response formats; expanded Sentry coverage to surface silent production failures.

items.label: Jan 2025 - Dec 2025
description: Developed full-stack features across a Remix frontend, Express.js microservices, and PostgreSQL database — including subscription flows, data-driven UI features, and API integrations end-to-end.
Built and maintained reusable components within a shared styled-components design system (Storybook), ensuring consistent UI patterns across multiple applications.
Implemented product listing interfaces with filtering, detail pages with dynamic layouts and data transformations, image galleries with resolution-optimized thumbnails, and loading skeletons.
Ported authentication and content features between codebases, refactoring to fit different design systems and application patterns.
Performed cross-browser functional and visual QA, then implemented responsive and accessibility fixes across the application.
Prepared the application for search engine indexing — added sitemap generation, improved SEO, corrected URL structures, and removed non-public content from crawlable pages.
